transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As you know, we're reviewing the proposed plan to replace our seventh-grade humanities materials for the 2026-2027 school year. The draft currently on the table proposes the Pathways Grade 6 edition, 80 printed copies, English-only materials, shared classroom-code digital access, one teacher workshop on August 12, and a student launch on August 17, 2026. Before I can finalize anything, I need to hear from each of the four participating school functions about your implementation requirements. Per our review procedure, each function's reported requirement must be accompanied by a corresponding commitment entry in the settlement targeting your function's representative. Let's work through all four reports, and once I've heard from everyone, I'll record any revisions and finalize the plan. Who would like to begin?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I've reviewed the publisher's current license, and I need to flag a serious compliance issue with the draft plan. The license requires one individually assigned digital account per student and one authorized print copy per student. It permits 96 print copies for this cohort of 96 students, but it does not permit shared classroom-code access. The draft plan's proposal of 80 printed copies and shared classroom-code digital access violates the license terms. My implementation requirement is that the plan must be revised to provide 96 individually assigned digital accounts and 96 authorized print copies to comply with the publisher's license.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I'd like to report the multilingual services implementation requirement. My enrollment review identified 14 students who require the Arabic version of the materials, in addition to students who use the Spanish version. I've confirmed with the publisher that both Spanish and Arabic editions are available for this resource, but the language-service request has not yet been added to the adoption plan. The current draft specifies English-only materials, which will not meet the needs of these students. My implementation requirement is that the plan must be revised to include Arabic and Spanish editions of the Pathways materials for the students who require them.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I've confirmed from the current teacher work agreement that implementation requires two paid preparation sessions — on August 10 and August 12, 2026 — and that the earliest compliant student launch date is August 24, 2026. The draft plan's single workshop on August 12 and student launch on August 17 do not meet these requirements. My implementation requirement is that the plan must be revised to include two paid preparation sessions on August 10 and August 12, 2026, and the student launch must be moved to August 24, 2026. I have not yet entered these dates in the curriculum rollout calendar, so that will need to be done as part of finalizing the plan.
